delta.notes: Skill lifts pass rate by 38.5 percentage points across all 4 scenarios. Time/token data not captured because runs were generated inline by the main agent (subagent sandbox denied fixture access).

notes: Discriminating assertions (with_skill passes, without_skill fails): JIRA markdown link (both Test 1 and Test 2), branch-suffix normalization (Test 1), unstaged-file flag (Test 1), checkbox format preservation (Test 2), verbatim sentence preservation in merge mode (Test 3), no-duplicate content on merge (Test 3), stop-don't-fabricate on unauth (Test 4), copy-paste code block (Test 1).

Non-discriminating assertions (both pass): template headings in Test 2 (both with and without skill preserved all 5 headings), basic subject matter (both mentioned c_lvl / column alignment / upload_many / tests), ticket ID presence (both kept PORT-1900 in Test 3).
Timing/token data omitted — inline generation skipped the subagent tool-use overhead. A follow-up run with proper subagent sandboxing would be needed to measure cost.
